actions.action: Merge paragraph versions instead of whole documents
actions.mechanism: A causal multi-value register preserves concurrent text versions while replacing only versions an edit explicitly supersedes.
actions.implementation: Key versions by paragraph ID and device/revision; attach two-device causal context, author, and original text. Union versions and retain causally maximal alternatives.
actions.check: Edit different paragraphs offline; reconnect in both orders. Assert both edits survive. Concurrent same-paragraph edits must retain both exact texts.
actions.risk: Logical revision numbers alone cannot establish cross-device causality.

actions.action: Represent deletion as a conflicting paragraph version
actions.mechanism: A deletion marker participates in causal comparison, preventing concurrent edits from disappearing when a paragraph is deleted.
actions.implementation: Store deletion operations with paragraph ID, author, revision, and causal context. Concurrent text and deletion remain an unresolved pair; retain the edited text.
actions.check: Delete a paragraph on one device and edit it offline on the other. Both reconnect orders must expose deletion-versus-edit alternatives.
actions.risk: Hiding deletion conflicts in ordinary trash would obscure unresolved work.

actions.action: Separate paragraph ordering from paragraph text
actions.mechanism: Independent move operations prevent a reorder from overwriting prose; deterministic replay gives replicas the same paragraph sequence.
actions.implementation: Record moves as paragraph ID plus predecessor ID. Replay causally, breaking concurrent ties by device/revision. Preserve deleted anchors as invisible sequence entries.
actions.check: Combine concurrent moves, text edits, and anchor deletion. Every delivery permutation must produce identical ordering and preserved text alternatives.
actions.risk: Deterministic ordering may surprise users; retain competing move history for explanation.

actions.action: Make conflict resolution an authored operation
actions.mechanism: Explicit resolution records explain which alternatives were reviewed without silently overriding edits the resolving device has never seen.
actions.implementation: Show original alternatives with authors, devices, and revisions. Save the chosen or combined text with references to reviewed versions and their causal context.
actions.check: Resolve a conflict, then deliver an unseen concurrent edit. Verify it remains a conflict rather than disappearing beneath the resolution.
actions.risk: Do not interpret logical revisions as reliable wall-clock chronology.

actions.action: Exchange durable operations through the existing connection
actions.mechanism: Idempotent operation transfer tolerates duplicate delivery, interrupted reconnects, and either device becoming the first sender.
actions.implementation: Persist operations transactionally before acknowledging receipt. Exchange missing per-device revision ranges through the existing transport; deduplicate by device/revision and track gaps explicitly.
actions.check: Interrupt transfer before and after acknowledgment, restart both devices, and resend duplicates. Assert identical operations, text, conflicts, and ordering after synchronization.
actions.risk: Reused device identities or revision counters can create operation collisions.

actions.action: Compact history without discarding unresolved alternatives
actions.mechanism: Acknowledged checkpoints reduce replay work while retaining conflict originals, provenance, and ordering anchors needed by offline operations.
actions.implementation: Checkpoint only a causal frontier acknowledged by both devices. Preserve unresolved alternatives and required tombstones; never expire them merely because 48 hours elapsed.
actions.check: Leave one device offline for 48 hours, compact the other, then reconnect with edits referencing old paragraphs. Assert no lost alternatives or broken anchors.
actions.risk: The paragraph limits do not bound accumulated conflict-history storage.

actions.action: Enforce limits without silently truncating conflicts
actions.mechanism: Admission checks keep authored paragraphs within limits while treating conflicting versions as alternatives, not additional live paragraphs.
actions.implementation: Define the 8 KB encoding measure and validate each version. For concurrent insertions exceeding 500 paragraphs, retain excess additions in an explicit pending queue.
actions.check: Merge two valid offline insertions into a 499-paragraph note. Verify 500 active paragraphs maximum, identical pending additions, and no discarded text.
actions.risk: Pending additions require a visible user decision, not hidden eviction.

actions.mechanism: A fixed operation trace and delivery permutations make convergence, authorship preservation, and deletion behavior falsifiable.
actions.implementation: Seed identical notes; script independent edits, conflicting text, moves, and deletion-versus-edit. Replay all deliveries respecting local creation order, including duplicates and restarts.
actions.check: Compare canonical paragraph order, exact alternative bytes, author/revision metadata, and conflict states across replicas; assert expected independent edits and deletion-versus-edit alternatives remain.
actions.risk: Convergence alone is insufficient: identically losing edits must fail explicit survival assertions.
